title: 第2章 试用脑波仪-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》
content:
第(1/3)页

    面板上开始显示详细的说明。

    【1、档案已植入国家级安全内网数据库，真实可查。招募流程完整，审批链闭环。】

    【2、招募宿主的直属领导周维国（国安总局某三处处长），于三天前因突发交通事故身亡。该领导是现实中唯一见过宿主、登记过宿主信息并完成秘密特招手续的人。】

    【3、因安全部门特招流程的高度保密性，周维国未向其他同事披露宿主真实身份，只在系统录入了资料。

    宿主亦未与安全系统内任何其他人员产生过接触。

    现实中无人认识宿主、无人见过宿主真实面貌、无人可核对宿主身份。】

    【4、档案备注：该特情人员背景干净，社会关系极少，外貌普通不易引起注意，适合隐蔽战线工作。

    特别是有极强的观察力，和记忆力，所以经秘密考察后特招。

    当前状态：独立潜伏，实习考察期。】

    顾承安一条条看完。

    不得不承认，逻辑是通的。

    直属领导死了——，是刚刚真实发生的交通事故，系统只是利用了这个信息窗口。

    档案在内网能查到，但没有活人能指着他说“我认识你”。

    秘密战线本身就要求隐蔽，一个外卖员的身份反而成了最好的掩护。

    完美的信息孤岛。

    但问题是——

    “我TM考了五年公务员，好不容易有了个机会，你给我分了个间谍工作？”

    【特别情报员，非间谍，在隐蔽在普通人群中，发掘间谍，偶尔配合上级执行任务，自由度较高。属于国家安全机关在编人员，当前行政级别为科员。】

    科员。

    顾承安愣了一下，随即发出一声轻笑。

    科员啊。

    前世拼了命想考的编制。

    这辈子以“国家安全机关秘密潜伏特别情报员”的方式拿到了。

    “行。”

    没什么好挑的了。

    【身份已激活。内部app可随时绑定到指定手机上！证件及相关资料物品需要联系上级领取】

    心念一动

    查看了下基因药剂的说明。

    【注射后将宿主体能、反应速度、五感、耐力等全方位提升至人类巅峰水平。

    非基因变异，不超越人体极限。适应期约半个月，会逐步改善至完美状态。】

    顾承安从系统提取出一支透明的注射器，像玻璃材质，管体内装着淡蓝色的液体，微微散发着令人着迷的蓝色光晕。

    他没犹豫，对着大臂外侧扎了进去。

    推注的瞬间，一股凉意沿着血管往四肢骨骼里钻。

    不疼。

    就是冷。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Detailed instructions begin to appear on the panel.

【1. The files have been implanted into the national security intranet database and are authentic and verifiable.The recruitment process is complete and the approval chain is closed.】

【2. Zhou Weiguo, the direct leader who recruited the host (director of a third division of the State Security Administration), died in a traffic accident three days ago.This leader is the only person in reality who has seen the host, registered the host's information, and completed the secret recruitment procedures.】

【3. Due to the high confidentiality of the security department’s special recruitment process, Zhou Weiguo did not disclose the host’s true identity to other colleagues and only entered the information into the system.

The host has not had contact with any other personnel in the security system.

In reality, no one knows the host, no one has seen the true face of the host, and no one can verify the identity of the host.】

【4. File note: This special agent has a clean background, few social connections, and an ordinary appearance that does not easily attract attention. He is suitable for covert front work.

Especially because of his strong observation and memory, he was specially recruited after a secret investigation.

Current status: Independent latent, internship and inspection period.】

Gu Chengan read it one by one.

I have to admit that the logic makes sense.

The immediate leader died——it was a real traffic accident that just happened. The system just used this information window.

The file can be found on the intranet, but no living person can point to him and say "I know you."

The secret front itself requires concealment, and the identity of a deliveryman has become the best cover.

The perfect information island.

But the problem is——

"I've been taking the civil service exam for five years, and finally got an opportunity. You assigned me a spy job?"

【Special intelligence agents, non-spies, hide among ordinary people, discover spies, and occasionally cooperate with superiors to perform tasks, with a high degree of freedom.He is a staff member of the national security agency, and his current administrative level is section member.】

Section member.

Gu Chengan was stunned for a moment, then chuckled.

Section member.

​​The establishment that I tried my best to take the test in my previous life.

In this life, I got it in the form of "a secret lurking special intelligence agent of the national security agency".

"Okay."

There is nothing to choose from.

【Identity has been activated.The internal app can be bound to the designated mobile phone at any time!Certificates and related materials need to be obtained from your superior]

A thought in my mind

Checked the instructions for the genetic medicine.

【After injection, the host's physical fitness, reaction speed, five senses, endurance, etc. will be improved to peak human levels.

Non-genetic variation, does not exceed the limits of the human body.The adaptation period is about half a month, and it will gradually improve to a perfect state.】

​​ Gu Chengan extracted a transparent syringe from the system, which was made of glass. The tube was filled with light blue liquid, exuding a slightly fascinating blue halo.

He didn’t hesitate and pierced the outside of the upper arm.

At the moment of injection, a coolness penetrated along the blood vessels and into the bones of the limbs.

It doesn’t hurt.

It’s just cold.
